final: WITH c AS (SELECT m.department AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), s AS (SELECT d, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_diff FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
